key.name: run-in-background
key.summary: Keep the app running after closing for faster startup
key.description: If true, closing the window hides it and the process keeps running; a later launch re-presents the window.

key.name: columns
key.summary: Number of columns in the emoji grid

key.name: skin-tone
key.summary: Default skin tone used for emojis that support it

key.name: paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste the selected emoji directly into the focused window
key.description: Requires the GNOME Shell extension; insensitive while the extension is absent.

key.name: multi-emoji
key.summary: Select multiple emojis consecutively before pasting

key.name: timeout-ms
key.summary: Time to wait after the last emoji selection before pasting

key.name: recents
key.summary: Internal: mirror of the most-recently-selected emojis
key.description: The authoritative store is $XDG_DATA_HOME/emoxidize/recents.txt (most-recent-first, capped at 40 entries); this key mirrors it for integrators and is applied live when written externally.
